subject: ctmm webapp v0.0.5 beta available for testing

messages.author: b0605a98663adee5
messages.subject: ctmm webapp v0.0.5 beta available for testing
parts:
ctmm webapp v0.0.5 beta available for testing at https://ctmm.shinyapps.io/ctmmweb/

Video tutorials can be found here: https://github.com/ctmm-initiative/ctmm-webapp/blob/master/README-demo.md

If you wish to install the app locally instead of using the cloud-hosted version, instructions are here: https://github.com/ctmm-initiative/ctmm-webapp

The functionality from the Import Data page through the Visual Diagnostics page is feature-complete and has passed our internal testing. We are looking for external feedback now, particularly from users deploying the webapp on their own data. The remaining pages (Model Fitting through Work Report) will be developed subsequently.

Additionally, the webapp currently features functionality that is not in the ctmm package, including automated outlier detection and removal, and visual (graphical) subsetting of datasets. It also features a several different types of plots that are particularly useful for comparing multiple individuals.

Please give it a try and let us know what works for you, what doesn't, and which additional features you'd like to see incorporated.

Thanks!

messages.subject: Re: ctmm webapp v0.0.5 beta available for testing
parts:
You can create an issue in the github repo (it was renamed a little bit to follow R package naming standard since it's a R package now)

https://github.com/ctmm-initiative/ctmmweb

I'm still working on some new features, and probably will update the hosted version to the latest version in the following days. You can use the current version locally (following the instruction in the project readme), and that will get the updates much faster than the hosted version.

Best,
Xianghui Dong
